title: Senior Analytics / Data Science Engineer
description:
About This Role
**5 to 8 years of experience**  

**Skills: Data Engineer**

**Job Title: Senior Analytics / Data Science Engineer**


**About the Role**


We are looking for a Senior Analytics / Data Science Engineer who sits at the intersection of data engineering and data science. In this role, you will build and own the data infrastructure that powers analytics and machine learning workflows — ensuring data is accurate, performant, and ready for insight. You will work closely with data science, engineering, and business teams to deliver production\-grade solutions that drive real decisions.


**What You'll Bring**


You have 5\+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or an equivalent technical role, with a track record of owning outcomes rather than just completing tasks.


On the technical side, you bring strong, hands\-on SQL skills and deep Snowflake experience — including performance tuning, warehouse management, and a genuine awareness of cost implications. You are comfortable with Python for data work, including pandas, NumPy, scripting, and writing tests. You have built and maintained data accuracy and quality frameworks, not just flagged issues.


You also have a solid foundation in statistics — distributions, sampling, hypothesis testing, regression, and confidence intervals — and a working knowledge of the data science workflow: exploratory analysis, feature engineering, and model evaluation metrics. You don't need to be a full ML engineer, but you understand the pipeline well enough to support and improve it.


**What We Value**


Beyond technical depth, we are looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates proactively, and brings a quality mindset to everything they ship. If something looks off in the data, you investigate it. If a process can be improved, you improve it.

Job Description: CDM Smith is seeking a Intermediate Data Scientist to enhance the capabilities of the Analytics team in Predictive Modelling and Computer Vision. This individual will have the opportunity to work alongside talented and innovative team members to drive Analytics initiatives that are transformative to CDM Smith. Under light supervision, this individual gathers data, creates Predictive Models and custom solutions. Primary responsibilities: • The individual will apply Machine learning algorithms and techniques. • Ability to apply a broad range of algorithms to varied data science problems including but not limited to Predictive Analytics, Computer Vision and Text Analytics. • Experience with supervised and unsupervised learning as well as extensive experience with Data Science languages like Python and R. • Design meaningful visualization using Qlik, Tableau or other tools. • Enhance Data collection procedures to include information that is relevant to building analytics systems. Data Science Skills: • Python, R, Deep Learning Neural Networks • Traffic Analysis using Computer Vision and AI. • Exposure to Azure AI or AWS Machine Learning Modules a plus. • Ability to write SQL queries as well as logical scripts. Nice to have skills: • OpenCV • Caffe2 • Azure Custom Vision • YOLO3 Minimum Qualifications: • Graduate degree (M Tech or PhD) with a specialization on computer vision, machine learning, data analysis is strongly preferred. • 3\+ years of related experience\- including delivering Predictive Analytics/Custom Vision solutions. • Some experience with Analytics/Business Intelligence tools such as Qlik, Birst, Tableau, Power BI, Spotfire, or comparable products. • Ability to create data visualizations and transform concepts into fully realized production applications. • Ability to learn the business and develop relationships that enhance the value of the Business Technology (IT). • Ability to manipulate SQL queries Skills \& Abilities: Intermediate experience with statistical computing and programming languages (ex: R, Python, Java, Scala, etc.) is required. Intermediate experience with data preparation, data manipulation languages, libraries, and visual ETL (extract, transform, load) tools in support of data science use\-cases is required. Understanding of machine learning techniques and algorithms. Possesses solid written and oral communication skills and ability to interact with varying levels of staff, as well as vendors. Demonstrates excellent organizational skills to balance and prioritize work. Intermediate data visualization skills. Intermediate knowledge of and ability to use data modeling software. Intermediate analytical, quantitative, and statistical skills. Intermediate knowledge of data cleansing, validation and general quality control principles. Qualifications: Bachelor's Degree. 3 years of related experience. Equivalent additional directly related experience will be considered in lieu of a degree. Domestic and/or international travel may be required. The frequency of travel is contingent on specific duties, responsibilities, and the essential functions of the position, which may vary depending on workload and project demands. Amount of Travel Required: No Travel is required Background Check and Drug Testing Information: CDM Smith Inc. and its divisions and subsidiaries (hereafter collectively referred to as “CDM Smith”) reserves the right to require background checks including criminal, employment, education, licensure, etc. as well as credit and motor vehicle when applicable for certain positions. In addition, CDM Smith may conduct drug testing for designated positions. Background checks are conducted after an offer of employment has been made in the United States. The timing of when background checks will be conducted on candidates for positions outside the United States will vary based on country statutory law but in no case, will the background check precede an interview. CDM Smith will conduct interviews of qualified individuals prior to requesting a criminal background check, and no job application submitted prior to such interview shall inquire into an applicant's criminal history. If this position is subject to a background check for any convictions related to its responsibilities and requirements, employment will be contingent upon successful completion of a background investigation including criminal history. Criminal history will not automatically disqualify a candidate. In addition, during employment individuals may be required by CDM Smith or a CDM Smith client to successfully complete additional background checks, including motor vehicle record as well as drug testing. Additional Compensation : All bonuses at CDM Smith are discretionary and may or may not apply to this position. Visa Sponsorship Available : No \- We are not open to sponsoring for this position

title: Data Science Trainer
description:
**Job Description**

iROHUB Infotech is hiring a Data Science Trainer cum Developer who has strong analytical skills and a passion for teaching. The role involves training students in data science concepts while also working on real\-time data\-driven projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct Data Science training sessions for students
* Teach Python for Data Science, Statistics, and Machine Learning concepts
* Mentor students in academic and real\-time projects
* Guide students in data analysis, model building, and deployment
* Prepare training materials, assignments, and assessments
* Review student performance and provide constructive feedback
* Work on internal or client\-based data science projects
* Coordinate with academic and placement teams

**Required Skills**

* Strong knowledge of Python, NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Seaborn
* Experience with Machine Learning algorithms
* Knowledge of SQL and databases
* Basics of Deep Learning is an added advantage
* Experience with tools like Jupyter Notebook, Google Colab
* Good communication and mentoring skills

**Note: We are looking for candidates who are interested in a trainer/teaching role only. This position is focused on training and mentoring students, not on project\-based or development work. Candidates interested exclusively in project roles are requested not to apply.**

**Interested candidates kindly WhatsApp your resume to 90720 66363**

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹15,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Experience:

* Data science: 1 year (Required)
* Mentoring: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: AI/ML Trainer
description:
Job Responsibilities

* Deliver classroom and hands\-on training on Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning concepts.
* Train students on Python programming, Data Science fundamentals, Machine Learning algorithms, and Deep Learning.
* Conduct practical sessions using real\-world datasets and industry\-oriented projects.
* Guide students in developing end\-to\-end AI/ML projects.
* Prepare training materials, assignments, assessments, and project documentation.
* Mentor students in coding, debugging, and problem\-solving.
* Stay updated with the latest AI/ML technologies and industry trends.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of **Python Programming**.
* Hands\-on knowledge of **NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib, Scikit\-learn**.
* Understanding of Machine Learning algorithms such as Regression, Classification, Clustering, Decision Trees, Random Forest, and SVM.
* Basic knowledge of **Deep Learning** using TensorFlow or PyTorch is an added advantage.
* Familiarity with SQL and data preprocessing techniques.
* Good communication and presentation skills.
* Passion for teaching and mentoring students.

Eligibility

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Candidates with prior teaching or industry experience in AI/ML will have an added advantage.

Benefits

* Free Accommodation Provided.
* Competitive salary based on experience and skills.
* Opportunity to work in a dynamic learning environment.
* Career growth and continuous learning opportunities.

Pay: ₹200,000\.00 \- ₹300,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person
